about.en: EverValue Coin (EVA) is a deflationary token on Arbitrum One designed to gain value against Bitcoin: an immutable on-chain Burn Vault holds WBTC, topped up with bitcoin mined by the project's own machines, and burning EVA redeems a pro-rata share of that WBTC, which sets a rising floor price in sats for the remaining supply. It is an ERC-20 at 0x45d9831d8751b2325f3dbf48db748723726e1c8c on Arbitrum One. It trades freely above that floor and is not pegged to bitcoin.
